thresholds._comment: Alarm if a species' spawn-% moves beyond absPts (boss decision 3), OR a rare-but-present species moves by relMult-fold (fresh-eyes addendum — catches relative swings the absolute gate misses on low-frequency phases). absPts is 3 standard errors for the seed count: 15 at 200 seeds, 39 at 30 (the boss's 2026-10-28 value), 34 at 40 (2026-10-31), 27 at 64 (2026-11-02). The 3-seed rare-species floor is also the boss's 2026-10-28 value. The floor (rel_move and appeared/disappeared) is max(minPctForRel, 100*minSeedsForRel/N) of the smaller sweep: 4.7% at 64 seeds, 7.5% at 40, 10% at 30, back to 2% at 200. On the 10-26 sweep's own seeds, disjoint 30-seed blocks of one engine raise 0.8 false alarms per pair at 39 pts / 3 seeds (mostly rel_move) vs 4.4 at 15 pts / 2%.
